story.text: Apuckalypse Meow was 1 OT away in the semi-finals from a "perfect" undefeated season.

Chris tore a ligament in his shoulder and Thomas broke his collarbone. These injuries and a relatively uncompetitive championship game put quite the damper on the best regular season in Squawks history.

Lost to Puck Norris 3 times by 1 with multiple scuffles per game than total goals.  Frustrating season following 3 straight title game losses. Wicked sandbagged and then swapped their HS/college kids for their pylons in the playoffs resulting in a championship.

Wicked changed their names to the Backdoor Bandits as a cheeky way to rub the nonsense they pulled last playoffs in everyone's faces. Apuckalypse Meow changed colors. The Squawks went on a REVENGE TOUR and you're goddamned right they got their mojo back. Still lost an OT heartbreaker in the title game. The Buffalo Bills gauntlet is complete.

WSC inexplicably started giving 3 points for wins. Reflected on this page only - keeping 2 pt wins in Overview tab  |  Video evidence for stats starting 9/27  |  Videos of each goal added starting playoffs

11/22 vs. Apuckalypse Meow: Gabe had the 3 highlights of the night and thus won 1st ⭐️ 

1. Dangle in front of the bench. Kitty boy undressed. MANEUVERED fro there with a pass. 

 2. Disgusting goal, but not in the sense of excellence. Randy unselfishly did a very delayed cross crease pass to Gabe. Gabe was skating AWAY from the play with his back turned to the puck. Pass hits his skate, hits a defensive player, and goes in. 🥅#62, 🍎 76

3. 10 seconds to go, Squawks up 6-4, Gabe mandangles…. = maneuvered + dangles, pulls to deep forehand deceptive set up, wrister release top cheese shelves it for disrespect goal. Skates to bench for knucks. Game buzzes during celebrations. Blouses 👚 to the birds. 🦅
THE WINTERSQUAWKS ARE YOUR FALL 2024 DIVISION 4 STANLEY KEG CHAMPIONS!

Introducing the Sqauwk 🏆: 4 points for 1st ⭐, 2 for 2nd ⭐, 1 for 3rd ⭐  |  Season winner receives the Spirit of the Squawkt rophy  |  7:55 games held at Sherwood Ice Arena. Standings tiebreaker is goals scored.
Hammerheads 1/31 - Mike Marsh gets a call up from the AHL to D4 Beer League and dazzles earning 1st star. Sei gets revenge on the refs. Nick scores our only shootout goal to preserve the tie.
Drunken Masters 2/7 - In the championship rematch, masters were down their starting goalie... and it showed.
Puck Fiction 2/21 - The curse of the Fish continues. "Take it easy on them" he says. Fiction's rent-a-goalie, Patrick, was a MONSTER, but this save from Dennis was the highlight of the game.
Hammerheads 3/21 - Mr. Retaliation #13 gets to think about this loss an extra week after his game misconduct to end the game, and bush league tripping earlier on Evan.

Drunken Masters 3/28 - Down 4-1 with 10 minutes to go, the Squawks rose from the ashes to tie it 2.5 shifts and less than 5 minutes later on the scrappiest, sloppiest, dirty bird goals you ever did see. In the shootout, Dennis shut the door on 91 and relied on his snow wall to keep a slapper perched on the red line by a millimeter, before Sean finally broke through their netminder on attempt #5. God bless hockey and god bless the Squawks. KAKAW!
Apuckalypse Meow 4/4 - Everyone forgot how to play hockey. We got bodied and dropped to 3rd, but Dennis had a sick double stack pad save. Onto the Ploffs!
Chiefs 4/11 - Bounced back in the 2nd half of the game after a sloppy start and barely let them into our zone. Dennis kickstarted the rally with this incredibile glove save on a breakaway.

Hammerheads 4/18 - EVERYONE SHOWED UP (literally, and also literally.)  Never running out of fresh legs has its advantages as we played the best game of Squawk hockey, possibly ever. Every shift had an effort play, but a few notable ones were when Dennis stoned 32, who took a ride on The Ross Train. Rob started playing baseball and Chayne's flying experiment crash landed.

Puck Norris 4/25 - For the second season in a row, a chance to avenge a Stanley Keg loss was on the table. This time against the Squawk's archrivals. AND WE FUCKING KICKED THOSE PUSSIES IN THE MOUTH. LET'S FUCKING GO SQUAWKS! BACK 2 BACK! BACK 2 BACK! LET'S GO SQUAWKS! SUCK OUR COCKS! FUCK PUCK NORRIS!

seasons.name: Summer 2025
seasons.story_title: President's Trophy winner's 3-peat bid comes up short

story.text: The white, winged jerseys have arrived. Rest in Paradise pony keg trophy, your watch has ended. Long live the full keg with a bowl on top trophy! Standings tie-breaker is goals scored.
Masters 5/9: WHITE IS RIGHT. The Squawks were lookin fly debuting the new, exciting hhwwwhite jerseys. Dennis was robbin' goals and smokin bowls. The quest to 3-peat starts off as good as it could.
Chiefs 5/16: Patrick from Puck Norris in net. Dennis (knee) and Ben (booty call) unavailable.
Meow 5/23: Sam Kaplin in net. Dennis (knee) and Ben (thesis) unavailable.

Norris 5/30: The goalie-go-round continues. Dennis (knee), Ben (Lodging it up in Scappoose) unavailable. Jared Brenner gets the call up from Div 5 Sherwood and PITCHES A SHUTOUT AGAINST AN UNDEFEATED TEAM?! (whaaaaa?) In other news, we got COACH MEGAN ON THE BENCH! Content was created and coach speak was at an all time high.
Fiction 6/6: Dennis (knee) and Ben (just wasn't feelin it) unavailable, Sam called up. Sean also tried his hand in net. Hinds brought out the big guns for a pro Squawks photo shoot.
Hammerheads 6/13: Dennis (knee) out, Ben and his shiny new degree in net. Fish swims a little too far up stream to stop 32 from scoring a breakaway.
Backdoor Bandits 6/20: Dennis (knee) out, Ben in net. Played opposite positions for 2 periods and went down 1-0. Won the 3rd 6-2 with 2 shorties playing normal positions.
Masters 6/27: Dennis out (knee), Ben (too wet) out, Patrick in net.
Meow 7/11: Dennis (knee) out, Ben (getting laid by science) out, Eric from Drunken Masters in net.
Norris 7/18: Dennis (knee) out, Ben (celibacy week) in net.

Fiction 7/25: Dennis (knee) out, Ben (working women's tourney, found time) in net. HOT DOG NIGHT! Gabe downed his dogs, opened up the scoring, flipped the bird, and was never seen again. Livebarn missing Stack's 1st goal.

Hammerheads 8/1: Dennis (knee) out, Ben (tired of sex) in net. After winning by 3 to lock up the President's trophy, we got a TIGHT 3 on the open mic from Mr. Chayne "fantasy last place 2025" Husband.
Chiefs 8/8: Dennis (knee) out, Ben (likes sex again) out, Jared Brenner asked to save maybe 9-10 shots. Finished the regular season with new Squawks records for points (23) and GAA (1.85.)

Fiction 8/15: Dennis (knee) out, Ben (big playoff energy) in net. No footage 1st 3 goals. Markstradamus shotgunned it, said it, thought about it, revised it, and it was so. Squawks break the President's trophy 1st round curse.

Masters 8/22: Dennis (knee) out, Ben (tired of boring dates) in net. No footage 1st 3 goals. The FLOCK showed up - friends, family, parents turning 59. It was over after 3 goals in the 1st within 3:13, with 1:36 actual gameplay.
Meow 8/24: Dennis (knee) out, Ben (embracing frat SQW) in net. They were the better team tonight. Fuckin sucks. No footage of goal 4.
No changes this season - promotions, demotions, or otherwise. Stadey continues to be a little bitch. Livebarn now needs a passcode - 6868

Bandits 8/29: TEAM LINDSAY. The debut of the first Teemu "City" Jerseys featured Randy's wife, the birthday girl, followed by drinks and merriment in the parking lot. The Squawkapella group was founded this night.
Chiefs 9/5: THE TRIUMPHANT RETURN OF DENNIS! Tearer of meniscuses, ravager of rehab. Randy stood on his head trying to breakdance. Nick's hatty put this one out of reach late.
Puck Norris 10/10: THE WINTERSQUAWKS 100TH FANCHISE WIN!

Hammerheads 10/31: 2 SPOOKY GHOST GOALS DOOM SQUAWKS. Despite no puck in the net, the refs called a goal for Hammerheads early in the 1st. Later while making another save, a puck was dislodged from Dennis's gear and play was stopped for a 2nd puck on ice. Refs did not disallow the original goal despite evidence it never happened. Later in the game, Dennis made a save that sat under him. Despite not seeing any evidence the puck crossed the goal line, the refs again awarded Hammerheads with a goal. Despite being out played and out reffed, the Squawks still had chances to tie it up at the end.
Puck Norris 12/5: 00 repeats "wrong division" in the handshake line which can only be described as the most pathetic chirp ever muttered. Outback Stackhouse's 150th game.

A winning effort but horrendous puck luck from the Squawks kept frustrations of a 3rd championship loss to Meow at bay. However, at the end of the day we are left with a familiar message: Try again next year.

seasons.name: Winter 2026
seasons.story_title: Squawks add Dunn-Bernstein, hope to solve Championship woes against Meow

story.text: Pour one out for Hindsy as he sails to Valinor as a 2 time keg winner. GM Murphy shows his mastery of cap manipulation in acquiring Michael Dunn-Bernstein. GET HYPED, MOTHERFUCKERS!
1/9 Hammerheads: As goalied as we got in the Championship game is how not-goalied we got tonight. Mikey makes a statement with 5 points and a HATTY in his debut.
1/16 Bandits: Slop it up! Wrong handed sticks, 7 minutes of passing around the o-zone, and good vibes from everyone on the ice.

1/30 Puck Norris: A smorgasbord of shenanegans included endless crying, bench warnings, and a cross check to Hendo's neck! Among other times they targeted Sean and cross checked others. 00 took 4 penalties. Blue socks was cool. Hendo's unsportsmanlike for chirping "Is that the 4th goal you've watched from the box, you fuck? Keep takin' 'em!" from the bench secured his claim to 1st star.
2/6 Chiefs: Pre game beers had us off to a slow start which we couldn't shake off until late in the 3rd, scoring 4 straight. WSC cut the livebarn feed at 12:30am, no footage of last 3 goals.

2/13 Meow: The pleaure chat has left the station! Emilee & Sydni showed up but were very disappointed with the lack of twizzles and gay sex. We played near perfect. Tip of the cap to the Hammerheads goalie again.

2/21 Puck Fiction: They're good now! Hard fought game coming back from down 0-2. However, after watching the Chiefs gloat during a 14-0 win v Bandits, the story of tonight, as it is every football season, is "Fuck the Chiefs."

3/13 Drunken Masters: A fitting game for Friday the 13th started with a ref losing his cool for an offisdes and sending Will to the box. Sean fanned on a shot and took it personally, Randy and Evan aggressively touched tips, Will scored his first goals of the season - a beauty and two of the dumbest goals you'll ever see - for a hattrick, and the Zamboni children almost committed manslaughter before crying about getting spwayed wif a wittle wata.
3/20 Norris: Fuck 00, fuck 11, and fuck this team. They deserved every bit of Eric's buzzer beater for goal #7
3/27 Chiefs: Justice was served. Benji got bored and decided to make his own magic.
4/3 Meow: The battle for 1st place couldn't have gone much better. After jumping out to a 3-0 lead in the first, the Squawks hunkered down with Meow only able to pot one during a 5 on 3 advantage.
4/10 Fiction: A short bench and a replacement goalie turned out to be too much to overcome against a revamped Puck Fiction team as The Squawks fumble the President's Trophy.

4/17 Norris: *Deep, elongated, annoyed sigh* Here we go again... 00 created some fireworks. Stadey saw this and said Randy 'broke the code.' He admitted avoiding accountability because he coaches Nate's kid.
4/24 Fiction: Benji in net for Fiction!?! All 4 Div-3 defensemen show up for Fiction?! No problemo. We have a Sei and a team of grinders ready to rip shots and fuck thots. On to the ship.
4/25 Meow: Hello darkness, my old friend. Now with a side of highway robbery.

seasons.name: Summer 2026
seasons.story_title: Sysiphus is a Bird Who Plays Hockey... AND FINALLY PUSHES THAT BOULDER TO THE TOP OF THE FUCKING MOUNTAIN

story.text: Get your boulders ready 'cause we're goin for another push up the mountain! Maybe we'll finally reach the top (again) - Italicized points added from WSC scorekeeper
5/1 Meow: A championship rematch 5 days after heartbreak and THE WINTERSQUAWKS 200TH GAME!... Ends in a Tie. Rob delivered our only shootout goal.

5/8 Drunken Masters: For the 2nd time in 2 weeks, a goal was missed. Rob did his best flightless bird impression falling on his ass no less than 3 times, and everyone had a nice little scrap with Butterball at the end.
5/15 Chiefs: FUCK MARK! FUCK MARK! FUCK MARK! (Squawks embrace the Dark Side.) Steve Dangle roasts Mark's ass.
5/29 Fiction: Fuck with Cam Night! - Livebarn password didn't work for this day only.
6/19 Meow: A Stadey clipboard was found with names of prominent players on both teams pre-game, with clear note taking intentions during play as he scouted the match. HMM.....

6/26 Drunken Masters: Benji's first game in net for us this year and he secures the clean sheet in the shootout. Fish goes end-to-end, Gabe snipes the corner, and Berry does everything, everywhere, all at once.
6/29: Rink repairs kill the livebarn feed. No video after 6/26.
7/10 Chiefs: A few faster additions helped the Chiefs keep this one tight. Rumor has it 3 Meow players, goalie included, were asked to leave the league...
7/17 Hammerheads: Sean nets one on enemy goal keeper #1, Chayne scores from his ass and hits an empty netter in front of coworkers, and Rob kept falling on his ass in front of the Squives
8/21 Fuck Norris: 00 is back, albeit visibly neutered. Rob killed a guy with a trident.

8/28 Masters: Butterball literally flipped Nick over his shoulder. That was fucking crazy. But not as crazy as Sei's hatty to send it to OT or Nick's waterbottle popping winner. In sad news, our beloved brazilian butt-waxed winger is out for the season after breaking his ankle while tanning his taint.

8/30 Meow: WILL LEGACY GAME. Up 2-0 after 2 minutes. Down 4-2 halfway through. Tied 4-4 after Will's goal with 10 seconds left in the 2nd. Up 6-4 after Will completes the natty hatty on their Div3 sub goalie. Killed the last 8+ minutes and smothered the puck in their zone for the last 2 to finally claim our rightful places atop the mountain that is Div4 Beer League. Brews, Bergs, Pink Whitneys, and terrible Dub Pub food was enjoyed by all.

seasons.name: Fall 2026
seasons.story_title: After Conquering Pussies, Squawks Look to Shit On Everyone Else

story.text: Apuckalypse Meow has been fractured as 3 top players leave due to lack of vibes. Hickey starts season on IR. - Italicized points added from WSC scorekeeper
9/4 Fuck Norris: Oh bitch, bitch, bitch. New players, typical crap from Nate (00). Bury 'em and move on.
9/11 Chiefs: Guess they got gud. Hickey to the IR after getting pancaked into the boards in his other league. No more ankle for a while.
9/18 Masters: 1-sub is all we need. Chayne pots 2 while Thomas and Nick score in the shootout, proving that size (of bench) doesn't matter, it's how you use it.

10/2 Fiction: They got themselves a ringer! Cam decided to Passmore to Jakob Husek and his elite hockey prospects page, who had all 4 goals before a ref cut him off. Fiction cements themselves as top dog this season.

10/9 Hammerheads: A classic SQUAWKY Hockey game where we outshot them by a wild margin, but only led 2-1 midway through the 3rd when the insurance goals finally happened. Ross played the game of his life and was on Hatty watch, as the shot total was something like 49-17. A Hammerhead asked if we were moving up a league next season. Also, #4 continues to be a whiny bitch.

10/23 Fuck Norris: Chayne's having #2 and the double-dad strength scored for both of 'em! 69 tackled Evan B, and 00 ended the game early with a cheap shot on Sean. These clowns stopped playing hockey early in the 2nd.

11/13 Bandits: Jason arose from Lake Oswego this Friday the 13th, picking off Squawks 1 by 1 to assist the Bandits with their first ever non-loss to us. Hickey, Margolis, Henderson, Miller, and MDB have been sent to LTIR.
